item.text: Tolpis succulenta is a perennial flowering plant in the Asteraceae family, native to the Portuguese archipelagos of the Azores and Madeira. Growing over 40 cm long, older plants develop a woody base. It has smooth, toothed leaves and yellow flowers scattered along its stems.
